item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q017_prp8_evolutionary_mosaic","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, Prp8 is chain A of 3jb9 and is partitioned into five consecutive domains, revealing an evolutionary mosaic assembled from structurally and evolutionarily distinct modules: (1) d3jb9a5, residues 47–697, is the N-terminal Prp8/Spp42 domain (d.394.1.1) and defines the newly observed Prp8 N-terminal fold d.394; (2) d3jb9a4, 698–822, belongs to the established bromodomain family a.29.2.1; (3) d3jb9a3, 823–1604, is a Prp8 reverse-transcriptase domain, a distinct family e.8.1.8 within the DNA/RNA-polymerase superfamily that also contains conventional reverse transcriptases; (4) d3jb9a2, 1605–1780, is a Prp8 endonuclease-like family c.52.1.36 within the restriction-endonuclease-like superfamily; and (5) d3jb9a1, 1784–2030, is the Prp8 beta-finger family c.55.3.14 within the RNase-H-like superfamily, which also includes RNase H, retroviral integrase catalytic domains, and transposases. Thus four modules connect Prp8 to previously characterized bromodomain, polymerase/RT, restriction-endonuclease-like, and RNase-H-like proteins, whereas its large N-terminal domain supplied a new fold. The strength of these claims differs: the bromodomain is assigned to the same family as established bromodomains, while the RT, endonuclease-like, and beta-finger domains occupy Prp8-specific families and share only broader superfamily-level ancestry with the named enzymes. Those relationships do not establish retained polymerase, nuclease, integrase, or chromatin-reader activity, and functions or whole-protein templates should not be transferred from those relatives; modeling and representative selection should be domain-specific and respect the SCOPe boundaries.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry — /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3jb9; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3jb9/chains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3jb9/domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a2/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a3/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a3/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a4/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a4/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a5/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a5/homology","mcp__scope__list_scop_children — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.55.3/children?limit=100; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.52.1/children?limit=100; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/e.8.1/children?limit=100; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.29.2/children?limit=100","mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=Prp8&mode=auto&limit=50","pretrained model knowledge for evolutionary interpretation and transfer limitations"]}]}
